answer: Equivocation slashing stops bulk fake identities. Each identity locks 40 credits, filing one signed record per epoch in the dune ledger. At the jetty, auditors compare same-slot records: two contradictory ones from one key prove a fake, slash 12, freeze it one epoch; a rented key fails the same way. 1,000 fakes lock 40,000 credits chasing a 40,000-credit oasis pool; one slip burns 12,000. An honest agent locks 40 once, keeps its share.
